files.description: Primary EHI Export Documentation (4 pages). Contains export instructions with screenshots, API endpoint for bulk export, query parameters (_since, _type), authentication details, and 'Scope of EHI' listing 15 data categories. Revised 03/17/25.

FHIR API Documentation (40 pages). Comprehensive FHIR R4 API reference covering SMART App Launch authorization, Bulk Data 1.0.1 export, 21 FHIR resource types with search parameters and USCDI data class mappings. Referenced by the EHI export PDF for format details. Revised 03/17/25.

OpenAPI 3.0.1 specification for the MaximEyes FHIR API. Machine-readable endpoint definitions for all FHIR resources including Account, ChargeItem, and Coverage (billing resources not documented in the PDF). Includes Export, Status, and Download endpoints for Bulk Data.
